sections.title: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property

rows.label: Corporate tax [national]
rows.value: 0% on taxable income up to AED 375,000, 9% above; 0% on the qualifying income of Qualifying Free Zone Persons; 15% minimum effective rate (domestic top-up tax) for multinational groups with revenue of €750 million or more from 2025; natural persons only above AED 1,000,000 of business turnover; Dubai: 20% tax on foreign banks (corporate tax deducted). Paid by companies and other juridical persons, natural persons in business above the turnover threshold, and non-residents with a permanent establishment in the UAE. Federal Decree-Law No. 47 of 2022, Art. 3; Cabinet Decisions No. 116 of 2022, No. 49 of 2023 and No. 142 of 2024; Dubai Law No. 1 of 2024.

source.title: Ministry of Finance: Federal Decree-Law No. 47 of 2022 on the Taxation of Corporations and Businesses and its amendments (consolidated English text, v13.1.26; amended by Decree-Laws 60/2023, 40/2024 and 28/2025)

rows.label: Tax on branch profits and distributed profits [national]
rows.value: none: no branch profits tax; 0% withholding tax on UAE-source income of non-residents; dividends from UAE companies are exempt income for the receiving company. Paid by no one (the withholding rate is 0%). Federal Decree-Law No. 47 of 2022, Art. 11(5), 12(3), 22 and 45.

source.title: Ministry of Finance: Federal Decree-Law No. 47 of 2022 on the Taxation of Corporations and Businesses and its amendments (consolidated English text, v13.1.26; amended by Decree-Laws 60/2023, 40/2024 and 28/2025)

rows.label: Self-employed contributions (pensions and social security) [national]
rows.value: none for expatriates: the pension schemes cover UAE nationals (employees: 11% insured, 15% employer) and GCC nationals under their own country's law; a GPSSA scheme for self-employed UAE nationals is under review. Paid by no one for expatriate self-employed people. Federal Decree-Law No. 57 of 2023; Federal Law No. 7 of 1999; GCC Insurance Protection Extension.

source.title: u.ae: Pensions and social security for UAE citizens (updated 14 October 2026)

rows.label: Contractor or employee: Labour Law test and freelance permits [national]
rows.value: no withholding on payments to contractors; an employee works under the employer's supervision and direction for a wage; freelancers work under a freelance permit; a natural person's business pays Corporate Tax only above AED 1,000,000 of turnover. Paid by the contractor (Corporate Tax and VAT where the thresholds are passed). Federal Decree-Law No. 33 of 2021, Art. 1 and 7; Federal Decree-Law No. 47 of 2022, Art. 45; Cabinet Decision No. 49 of 2023.

source.title: u.ae: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships (English translation published on the UAE government portal)

rows.label: Simplified regime: Small Business Relief [national]
rows.value: revenue up to AED 3,000,000 in the current and all previous tax periods; treated as having no taxable income; tax periods ending on or before 31 December 2029; VAT registration mandatory above AED 375,000. Paid by no one: it is a relief that resident persons can elect. Federal Decree-Law No. 47 of 2022, Art. 21; Ministerial Decisions No. 73 of 2023 and No. 131 of 2026.

source.title: Federal Tax Authority: Corporate Tax topics, Small Business Relief (page last updated 6 May 2024)

rows.label: Non-resident tax on employment income [national]
rows.value: none: no income tax on individuals, and wages are outside Corporate Tax for resident and non-resident natural persons; tax residence after 183 days (90 days with conditions). Paid by no one. Cabinet Decision No. 49 of 2023, Art. 2; Cabinet Decision No. 85 of 2022, Art. 4.

source.title: u.ae: Other taxes (updated 28 October 2026)

rows.value: no federal property tax confirmed (under review); Abu Dhabi: 5% of the rental value a year from tenants (at least AED 450; nationals exempt for their homes) and 1% to 4% a year on vacant non-residential land; Dubai housing fee on rent under review. Paid by tenants, and owners of vacant non-residential land in Abu Dhabi. Abu Dhabi Executive Council Resolution No. 49 of 2018, Art. 4 and 8.
